title: Sidecars saved by the DAW read as exactly what the DAW showed
description:
## Behavior
Sidecars saved by the DAW itself read as exactly what the DAW showed (the owner's reference files, M0).

```gherkin
Feature: Reading the DAW's own sidecars

  Scenario: An .asd saved by the DAW gives the markers the DAW showed
    Given the reference file "steady-120.wav.asd" saved by the DAW
    When I read it
    Then its warp markers are the ones listed for it in the fixtures README
    And warping is on with mode "complex"

  Scenario: An .alc saved by the DAW gives its region and settings
    Given the reference file "detuned.alc" saved by the DAW
    When I read it
    Then warping is on with mode "beats"
    And the detune is -30 cents
    And the loop is 2 bars long
    And it refers to the audio file "detuned.wav"

  Scenario: A clip saved with warping off reads as unwarped
    Given the reference file "free-time.alc" saved by the DAW
    When I read it
    Then warping is off and there are no warp markers

  Scenario: A warp mode Apricity does not have is named, not guessed
    Given a reference .alc saved with the DAW's "Tones" mode
    When I read it
    Then the warp mode is reported as "tones (no Apricity equivalent)"
```
